data.name: Rajiv
data.gender_notes: Rajiv is used as a male name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit rajīva, 'lotus'. Its root is Sanskrit rajīva (रजीव). A classical Sanskrit term for the lotus. Rajiv is a Sanskrit name meaning “Lotus; (also) striped”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Rajiv expresses “Lotus; (also) striped”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rajiv total 24, reducing to 6. Number 6 is associated with responsibility, care and harmony.
